decision: Issue #395; Sam approved the customer and warehouse lookups; PM agentmsg 56824a29 specifies one functional case per endpoint
purpose: Verify the warehouse reference endpoint authorizes each approved role and returns only the four reference fields, including inactive warehouses
data: Two synthetic warehouses (one active and one inactive) and four single-permission synthetic users in an isolated MySQL schema
concurrency: One application and sequential HTTP requests
repetitions: One case execution per matching routine functional test run
thresholds: Three independently allowed permissions return exact 200 projections; one unrelated permission returns 403; literal search, stable paging, status filter and schema boundaries hold
trigger: Existing routine native functional discovery; no new job, dispatch or performance workload
cost: Observed about 1.27 seconds of case execution per local real MySQL 26.7.0 run in UTC and Asia/Hong_Kong, excluding shared runtime and migration initialization; CI critical-path impact unmeasured

cases: Warehouse references let each permitted role search active and inactive warehouses without exposing master details
